Crystal practices: step by step

How the accounts say to choose, clear and use a quartz crystal for contact, energy and intention work. Everything here is a claim from the accounts, not tested science. Stop any session if you feel unwell, and never work with mains electricity.

The rules of contact

Speak a little Taami

Taami is the old Lyran (Man) language and the official diplomatic language of the Galactic Federation of Worlds. Endings: -a feminine, -u masculine, -i plural. After a long Pleiadean presence on Earth, traces of it survive in Earth languages. Many races speak their own languages: Grays sound like crackling insects, some speak in frequencies like dolphins and whales, and the O communicate in a way beyond telepathy.
